description: This file defines the code-behind for the CalculatorScientificOperators view in a calculator app, handling UI interactions, state changes, and visibility toggling for scientific calculator functions.

classes.name: CalculatorScientificOperators
classes.description: A partial class representing the scientific operators view in the calculator app, managing UI state and user interactions.

methods.name: CalculatorScientificOperators
methods.description: Constructor initializing the component and setting up the ExpButton shortcut.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Property returning the view model associated with this view.

methods.name: IsErrorVisualState
methods.description: Property indicating whether the error visual state is active.

methods.name: OnIsErrorVisualStatePropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the IsErrorVisualState property, updating visual states accordingly.

methods.name: OpenParenthesisButton_GotFocus
methods.description: Event handler for when the open parenthesis button gains focus, triggers narration announcement.

methods.name: ParenthesisCountToString
methods.description: Converts a count of parentheses to a string, empty if zero.

methods.name: ShiftButton_Check
methods.description: Event handler for checking the shift button, updates operator row visibility.

methods.name: ShiftButton_Uncheck
methods.description: Event handler for unchecking the shift button, resets state and focus.

methods.name: TrigFlyoutShift_Toggle
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of trig functions based on shift state.

methods.name: TrigFlyoutHyp_Toggle
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of hyperbolic trig functions.

methods.name: FlyoutButton_Clicked
methods.description: Resets trig and hyp buttons and hides flyouts.

methods.name: ShiftButton_IsEnabledChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the shift button's enabled state.

methods.name: SetOperatorRowVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility of operator rows based on shift button state.

methods.name: SetTrigRowVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility of trig function rows based on toggle states.

methods.name: ClearEntryButton_LostFocus
methods.description: Handles focus change for the clear entry button, shifting focus as needed.

methods.name: ClearButton_LostFocus
methods.description: Handles focus change for the clear button, shifting focus as needed.
